_description: ARK Test Steward healing policy — governs what AI can auto-fix vs. what requires manual review.

auto_apply_allowed.description: CSS class or structure changed but the semantic target (data-wb-*, getByRole, accessible label) is the same
Replace fragile CSS/text selector with stable data-wb-* attribute from UI inspector
Add or adjust waitForSelector/waitForTimeout to handle legitimate async rendering

manual_review_required.description: Changing test workflow steps, transitions, or sequence
Changing expected monetary amounts, totals, or calculations
Changing capability expectations or permission checks
manual_review_required.example: Removing capability requirement from test assertion

manual_review_required.description: Any modification to non-test source files (handlers, services, templates)
manual_review_required.example: Fixing a handler bug to make a test pass

forbidden.description: Deleting or commenting out an assertion to make the test pass
Adding test.skip() or test.fixme() to bypass a failing test
Wrapping assertions in try/catch or .catch(() => false) to silence failures
Blindly increasing timeouts instead of diagnosing the root cause
